blocks.body:
## Results and Boundaries

2025In the annual test, Decision treeAUCThe maximum is0.524, Time blockBootstrapinterval is0.349 - 0.691, Across0.5; The remaining three models also did not pass the predictive ability test.. AUCRecalculation and label checks did not find mechanical errors, 20Day label overlap, A small number of single-stock samples and insufficient information coverage are the main boundaries of the current design.. This is not a model that can be used for trading.

## Reading the boundaries

- In total370Weekly record, But of the adjacent weeks20Day label overlap, Full-period approximate independent window approx.91one, 2025About year12one. 
- The current interval is wide, Relational commutation cannot be distinguished, Weak signal and sampling fluctuation. 
- Pipeline checks can only rule out mechanical errors, Cannot prove that labels and data design are sufficient. 
- The model only predicts the direction of excess returns, No output amplitude, Trading costs or positions are not calculated. 
- Variables are not re-selected after the test set is opened, Che-in or post-reversal probability.
